name: part-definition
assumes: A placed part on a version-3 page, looked up by its package name. section-pin-map picks the section of a multi-section package within the definition this table picks
Each definition's pin map has the symbol's pin count. Where the Packages/ and Cache maps differ in length, the pin-count rule of docs/cadence-dsn-format.md §5.9 chooses between them
own_library 'not named': the instance carries no library string, because the Library string table could not be read
